description: Korean patent, utility model, design and trademark deadlines (특허법·실용신안법·디자인보호법·상표법): priority claim 12 months (6 for designs and trademarks), grace period for own disclosure 12 months, PCT national phase 31 months, examination request 3 years, office action response period, appeal or re-examination 3 months from a final rejection, registration fee within 3 months of the grant decision (+6 months late), terms (patent and design 20 years from filing, utility model 10, trademark 10 from registration) and the trademark renewal window (last year before expiry, or 6 months after). First day excluded and holiday roll-over. Follow the office's notice when it differs.

disclosed.description: Date the applicant disclosed the invention or design

noticeMonths.description: Response period in months on the notice (default 2)

today.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD for days left (default: today)
